audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed between layers (full gave Skill on rows 2-3-5 while content gave Ahri) and packet flags the chart as contradicting Swain's 53.3% WR.
audit.why: Pre-6 Ahri's 975-range Charm and 970-range Q outrange Swain's 750 Q and 850 E, so rows 2-3 are hers; level 6 Demonic Ascension vs Spirit Rush is a stand-off; first item onward evens out and favors Swain's scaling per the win rate.

audit.why: Spikes correctly named: Charm at 3, Spirit Rush at 6, first-item burst window, Swain late drain-tank. Content spikes[0..3] are grounded.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no cooldown number; Ahri's Q true-damage return (resistances-invalidated) and Essence Theft sustain (needs-antiheal) were unmentioned; widespread he/his for a female enemy.
audit.why: Charm is 12s flat, Spirit Rush 140/120/100s, Swain E 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — these numbers make the trade windows concrete. Ahri's Q deals true damage on return so MR does not reduce it.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with real numbers; pronouns corrected throughout; true-damage return noted in enemyWin rewrite.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown windows were described with no numbers.
audit.why: Charm 12s and Spirit Rush 140/120/100s are the two windows that decide every fight.
